boundaries: Empirical studies, descriptive taxonomies, official product practices and AG defaults are distinct. Partial/full access is recorded. No universal sales/comprehension gain is claimed.

sources.title: Assertion–evidence slide research
sources.scopeAndLimits: Author research summary/search excerpt reviewed; direct page timed out. Technical-presentation studies compare message headlines with visual evidence against topic/bullet slides. Do not generalize to every audience, handout or sales outcome.

sources.title: Sarikaya et al.: What Do We Talk About When We Talk About Dashboards?
sources.scopeAndLimits: Author page and indexed preprint reviewed. Descriptive dashboard corpus/taxonomy; useful for separating purpose, audience and interaction. Not a causal ranking or the AG tier system.

sources.title: Heer and Bostock: Crowdsourcing Graphical Perception
sources.scopeAndLimits: Author abstract reviewed. Tests selected perception tasks/encodings and study methods. It does not establish one chart winner for every dataset or audience.

sources.title: Segel and Heer: Narrative Visualization
sources.scopeAndLimits: Author abstract reviewed. Case-study framework balances authored sequence and reader exploration. It is not a universal causal performance result.

sources.title: Packard and Berger: How Concrete Language Shapes Customer Satisfaction
sources.scopeAndLimits: Publisher abstract and study excerpts reviewed. Evidence concerns concrete language in service/customer interactions. Do not promise the reported effects for decks, landing pages or an untested audience.

sources.title: Microsoft: Create and share a Dashboard with Excel
sources.scopeAndLimits: Official guide reviewed. PivotTables, charts, slicers and their connections require real workbook testing; capability depends on target Excel and authoring tool.

sources.title: Microsoft: Available chart types in Office
sources.scopeAndLimits: Official chart reference reviewed. Supported chart types are product capabilities, not proof of optimal comprehension or a mandate to use decorative3D.

sources.title: Microsoft: Accessible PowerPoint presentations
sources.scopeAndLimits: Official guidance reviewed: reading order, meaningful titles, alternatives and checking. Automated checker results are not a complete target-AT or projection test.

sources.title: Microsoft: Accessible Excel spreadsheets
sources.scopeAndLimits: Official guidance reviewed: structured tables, descriptive sheets/A1, chart alternatives and checks. Avoid merged/split data tables; do not infer full accessibility from a visual render.

sources.title: Microsoft Learn: PowerPoint ChartData.IsLinked
sources.scopeAndLimits: Official API reference reviewed. External workbook links differ from embedded data. Verify the chosen producer/target behavior; do not assume every chart is editable or self-contained.

sources.title: CDC Clear Communication Index
sources.scopeAndLimits: Official tool reviewed. Audience, main message, action and numeric communication are useful questions. Health-communication scoring is not a sales/conversion certificate.

sources.title: UNECE: Making Data Meaningful, Part1
sources.scopeAndLimits: Official indexed publication summary reviewed; full PDF returned403. Limited basis: statistics should be explained for non-specialists. No detailed quotation or full-text study claim.

sources.title: Obys — Grids
sources.scopeAndLimits: Прочитана индексируемая авторская инструкция: диагонали, пересечения и выбранные power lines. Интерактивная страница не отдала текст при прямом чтении. AG профиль и допуски являются собственной политикой.

sources.title: sfi0zy — Golden canon grid: страшилка для фронтендеров
sources.scopeAndLimits: Прочитан авторский разбор конструкции и CSS. Его 20-ячеечный пример не является единственной сеткой; код и фирменные шаблоны не копировались.

sources.title: Bonnie&Slide — Сильная презентация
sources.scopeAndLimits: Практический материал автора; не доказательство универсального прироста качества. Проверено 2026-10-28.

sources.title: VisualMethod / Skillbox — 17 советов
sources.scopeAndLimits: Прочитана статья. Иерархия, единообразие и читаемость полезны как практика; универсальные лимиты текста, проценты запоминания и психология цвета не принимаются как доказанные законы.
